text: Councillor Kristyn Wong-Tam, Chair, Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee will give a presentation to the Committee on recent initiatives and updates.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards to: a. consider the new designation of an accessible taxi brokerage, outlined in the submission from Checker Taxi, as part of the report to the General Government and Licensing Committee on June 24, 2019; and b. provide an update to a future meeting of the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee.
